messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: streaming-service-us-west-2 experiencing sudden tail latency and stalled chunks. Affected variant: open-13B-int8-canary. Metrics snapshot: p95=900ms (SLO 600ms), p99=2600ms (SLO 1200ms), streaming stall rate +700% vs baseline. Paging @ryan (oncall)

ryan (oncall): oncall ryan here. grabbing dashboards. Any recent deploys/canaries around 23:45-00:30 UTC?

eli (runtime): yes—there was a canary push for int8 calibration: int8-canary-2026-03-15 promoted to 10% traffic at 2026-03-15T23:58Z. I see a sharp increase in "stream_chunk_gap" and dequant process CPU. Logs:```
[2026-03-16T00:02:12Z] conn=xyz model=open-13B-int8-canary chunk_id=42 stall=true gap_ms=1500 dequant_ms=980 kv_miss=true
[2026-03-16T00:02:13Z] conn=abc model=open-13B-int8-canary chunk_id=7 dequant_ms=1200 locked_dequant=true
```

samir (ml): we rolled a tighter scale-range calibration to reduce avg quant error (int8-canary-2026-03-15). It passed unit and perf checks on short sequences. We didn't exercise prolonged KV miss patterns in canary.

priya (sre): initial mitigation suggestions: 1) pull canary weight to 0% ASAP; 2) enable fp16 fallback for active streaming sessions longer than 1024 tokens; 3) temporarily increase dequant worker pool to handle backlog. @eli can you take 1 and 2? @vera please flag customers.

eli (runtime): executing routing rollback + fallback rule:```bash
redwood route update --route open-13b-stream --variant open-13B-int8-canary --weight 0 --region us-west-2
redwood route rule add --route open-13b-stream --if stream_tokens>1024 --then variant=open-13B-fp16-fallback --region us-west-2
```
deploy-bot: routing change applied; rule propagation ~20s.

jon (support): CS notes: 9 tickets in last 10m, 2 marked urgent (live timeouts). Customers saw partial streaming or repeated reconnects. I'm drafting a short customer note.

priya (sre): scaled dequant pool +40% to give breathing room:```bash
infra scale pool dequant-workers --region us-west-2 --percent +40
```

eli (runtime): after actions (1m window): p95 down to 610ms, p99 down to 980ms, stall rate back to ~1.4x baseline. Still watching. No error budget burn yet but close for a few tenants.

samir (ml): thanks. I'll pause any further autopromote of calibration changes. Hypothesis: the new calibration changes increased pathological bit patterns for some token distributions, which in turn causes an expensive dequant path with additional checks (bounds and NaN mitigation) that spike CPU and block streaming chunks when KV cache misses cause synchronous dequant. Repro plan: synthetic long-stream with injected KV miss spikes + measure dequant microprofiling. I'll own repro and a safer calibration iteration.

ryan (oncall): assign owners & timeline: samir -> RCA and safe calibrations (48h), eli -> runtime mitigations and add a short-circuit to avoid sync dequant on hot paths (72h), priya -> autoscale knob & runbook update (24h), vera/jon -> customer comms and ticket summaries (now + followup). Severity S2. Postmortem owner: samir.

vera (cs): sending immediate customer update: "We observed a short-lived degradation affecting streaming responses. We have routed long sessions to a fallback and rolled back the canary. We're investigating root cause and will follow up with a postmortem." Sending to the two escalated accounts now.

eli (runtime): added extra telemetry flags to dequant operator to emit per-chunk histograms and lock wait times. Also collecting flamegraph dumps for any >500ms dequant samples.

priya (sre): additional note for postmortem: capture scheduling delay on dequant-workers, thread contention metrics, and KV cache miss correlation by client id. I'll create dashboards.

samir (ml): implementing a short-term guardrail: calibration autopromote only after passing a "long-sequence with KV miss" synthetic test and requiring 1h canary at >=5% traffic with streaming traces inspected.

eli (runtime): final snapshot at 00:30 UTC after rollback/fallback/scale: p95=570ms p99=840ms (5m avg). Marking incident as MITIGATED. If any customer sees regression, reopen thread.

incident-bot: Incident MITIGATED  timeline and logs uploaded to /incidents/2461122334/artifacts.

ryan (oncall): creating ticket INF-5281: "Investigate int8-canary-2026-03-15 causing streaming tail stalls; add gating + runbook updates." Assigning samir. Due: 72h for full postmortem.

samir (ml): will attach repro script and initial diff for safer calibration. Adding temporary block on autopromote to mainline.

vera (cs): I'll send personalized notes to affected customers with ETA for postmortem and optional 1:1s.

ryan (oncall): closing paging. Thanks everyone for fast response. :white_check_mark:
